chunks: In fact, I allowed them and their fathers to enjoy this life till the truth, and the apostle preaching it lucidly, came to them.

key_terms.الْحَقُ: The Truth (often referring to God or the final message)
key_terms.مَتَّعْتُ: I allowed to enjoy / I granted enjoyment

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by God 'allowing' people to enjoy life before sending a messenger?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom behind the postponement of punishment, framing the 'enjoyment' (metaa) as a temporary respite for the disbelievers and their forefathers to reflect. The arrival of the 'Truth' and the 'clear Messenger' marks the definitive end of this period of grace, establishing the prophetic mission as the ultimate criterion for accountability.
